meta.audience: front-end makers who want small delights on their buttons and cards
meta.title: Motion Kit
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from the app: source/README.md, its design tokens (src/styles in the app repository), its snippets and its captured screens. Electric blue #0B2FE6 hero, paper #EEF0F7 gallery, ink #0A0D1F, lilac and orange accents; the reel is made of the app's own animations, stepped frame by frame, and of its own confetti recipe.

source.notes: 27 vanilla micro-interactions to touch, tune and copy; the code you see is the code that runs; an easing lab
the real app (its production build, served locally) captured by capture/app.json; the confetti, ripple and heart frames are its own snippet animations paused and stepped in the demo iframe
Pretendard Variable (the app's face) and JetBrains Mono (code, labels); SIL OFL 1.1

rationale.palette: The app's tokens: electric blue #0B2FE6 (the hero, primary buttons) with #0925C4 / #050F52, paper #EEF0F7 / #F6F7FB, ink #0A0D1F / #353B5C, and the confetti colours its code uses (#0B2FE6, #C9B8FF, #FF6A2B, #FFFFFF, #7FE7FF): lilac and orange as accents.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable at 900 for headlines (the app's '클릭 한 번에 작은 즐거움을.' with its orange period), white on the blue stage and ink on paper; JetBrains Mono for code and labels.
rationale.motion: Bouncy and exact: springs with a little overshoot (the app's own favourite curve, cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), drives the reel's entrances), a cursor that taps, and the app's animations played back frame by frame at their own timing.
rationale.sound: Bright pop in F major at 128 BPM (8 bars in 15 s, 16 in 30 s): light and cheerful for a kit of small delights, with glassy SFX (a pop for every tap, sparkles for confetti).
rationale.visuals: Four scenes in the 15 s cut: the name and the app's line over the blue stage as a tap bursts confetti made with the app's own recipe; the real demo stage playing the app's confetti, ripple and heart animations; the real code panel changing as its slider moves (count: 36 to 72); the end card. The 30 s cut adds the easing lab's bezier editor.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short, muted launch reel with slogan-length Korean copy shown as type.
